mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired skin segment was most worthwhile: the scar stayed at its original location, and its vessels and nerves joined the surrounding skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the eye and ears felt predictable, especially when the ears were the only combination left.

surprise.text: The gut result made the distinction between food staying in the tube and absorbed material crossing its lining especially clear.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; each piece had a clear matching location, though the order was mostly a preference rather than a meaningful puzzle.

continue.text: Probably not right away. Bringing the parts together was satisfying, but the placements were predictable and I would want more meaningful choices in another chapter.
